sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.ja_search: Japanese fallback (rule 10): ja.wikipedia.org (Black Clover), the pixiv encyclopedia and the namu.wiki Japanese spell list, read through search summaries only (the hosts are not fetchable from the build machine).
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Bone Magic (Bone Bullets / bones shaped by hand)
spells.note: Mode 0 of the book (Bone Bullets, which the wiki gives to Lucius), kept because mode 0 is never hidden.

spells.name: Bone Armor
spells.note: Not a spell page: the ja.wikipedia extract says his bones block almost every physical blow.

spells.name: Bone Magic: Eternal Fangs
spells.note: Countless bones protrude from the body, sharp enough to pierce through dense sand and puncture the target.

spells.name: Bone x Spatial Magic: Demon Sword Dainsleif
spells.ja: 魔剣ダーインスレイヴ
spells.note: A bone sword coated in offensive Spatial Magic: Zenon's second attribute came with his devil. Swinging it sends flying slashes of space.

spells.name: Bone x Spatial Magic: Spatial Rupture
spells.note: Union spell in the Space category; no description found: the page is the Dainsleif's flying slashes.

spells.name: Bone Sprout
spells.note: NEW shared page: bones sprouting from the ground, after the attribute description.

spells.name: Bone Blade
spells.note: NEW shared page: a bone shaped into a sword (the wiki: bones can be shaped into hand weapons).

spells.name: Branching Bone
spells.note: NEW shared page: the bone branches and ends in points (the wiki).

spells.name: Rib Cage
spells.note: The old shared page; this mod's own, not found in any source for Zenon.

spells.name: Extending Bone
spells.note: NEW shared page: bones extending to great lengths (the wiki).

spells.name: Bone Regrowth
spells.note: NEW shared page: bone mending the body (the wiki).

spells.name: Splinter Burst
spells.note: NEW shared page: bones bursting out of the body in every direction.

spells.name: Ossuary Wall
spells.note: NEW shared page: a wall of fused bone.

spells.name: Bone Forest
spells.note: NEW shared page: a stand of tall bones.

spells.name: Bone Rain
spells.note: The old shared page; this mod's own, not found in any source for Zenon.

notes: Not in his grimoire (kept in the basic Bone book): Rib Cage and Bone Rain are this mod's own pages (old book), not found in any source. His devil Beelzebub and the spatial cubes of the Spatial Mana Domination are not pages.
